summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I did (read-only audit, no edits made) I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` routing → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth layer (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx`).  **Finding: the code, as written, is correctly wired end-to-end.** Specifically: - Client has no localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlists (only theme uses localStorage). It always calls the real API with `credentials: "include"`. -
